column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:debug module
# Loadable debugging module. Import binds the `Debug` namespace:
# dump/trace) write to the host output as a side effect AND return a value,
# so these rows pin the returned value (the printed text is verified in the
# Go tests, where output is captured). The perf words run under the spec's
# fixed clock, so elapsed timings are deterministic; here we pin the result
# SHAPE (typeof) and leave exact step counts to the Go tests. Exact-value
# and no-panic behaviour is in lang/go/modules/debug_test.go.
# §1  printing — return the value (and print as a side effect)

column3: tap prints then returns its arg unchanged
label prints "label: value" and returns the value
dump prints type + value and returns the value
a true assertion is a no-op (residual is the untouched 99)
a false assertion raises
todo is a typed hole that always raises
parse returns the token list (3 tokens) without running it
malformed source raises loudly
deps returns the distinct referenced words (add, mul)
explain returns the describe text as a String
words returns the list of built-in word names
defs returns the active def bindings as a map
modules returns the importable native modules
sizeof returns an estimated byte size
shape returns a structural census map
shape on a bare type literal does not panic

column1: # §5  performance analysis (deterministic shapes under the fixed clock)

column3: steps returns the engine step count
time returns {result, elapsed-ms, steps}
bench returns timing stats over n runs
trace prints the step trace and returns the body result
profile returns a per-word step-count table

column1: # §6  not imported — the namespace is undefined without import

column3: `Debug` is undefined without `import`
